definition: A Kryllian Ancestry Gift. Layered exocuticle covers the body. While wearing no armor, base Damage Thresholds are Major 4 / Severe 6 instead of the default 2 / 4. Wearing armor overrides these values with the armor's own thresholds.

sources.evidence: Ancestry Gift, 12.05

ruleCard.label: With armor
ruleCard.value: The armor's own thresholds apply as normal.
